proof_body:
by
  intro a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ h
  constructor
  · intro hd
    rcases h with h | h
    · refine ⟨b₁ / a₁, by field_simp, ?_⟩
      field_simp
      linarith
    · refine ⟨b₂ / a₂, ?_, by field_simp⟩
      field_simp
      linarith
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl, rfl⟩
    ring
target_source: ∀ (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ℝ), (a₁ ≠ 0 ∨ a₂ ≠ 0) → (a₁ * b₂ - a₂ * b₁ = 0 ↔ ∃ k : ℝ, b₁ = k * a₁ ∧ b₂ = k * a₂)
